Standalone allowed_paths test is not production GRV guarded scan integration.
Direct allowlisted write-open attempt was refused; this negative probe does not establish general read-only authority.
Production owner rejects direct/nested/glob scans by default; approved positive GCS scanner integration remains unimplemented.
REQUESTER_PAYS emits x-amz-request-payer: requester; Google billing-project support not established.
Account/project are explicit supplied metadata, not proof of HMAC-associated service-account identity.
Native HTTPState body/request counters use pinned internal extension layout; loopback totals exactly match server, real GCS TLS/backend metrics not yet exercised.
Measured totals include view binding and EXPLAIN; native_http.query excludes these phases but includes scan binding.
